column1: # Manufacturer specifications, transcribed to check the reference set against
# Sources: flyozone.com and the manufacturers' own published tables
# A dash means the maker does not publish that figure. BGD give area, span,
# aspect ratio, cells and projected area but not root chord, so the chord
# column is blank for the Lynx 2 rather than holding a number I worked out.
# I filled those five in first, from area and span, and the check then
# reported five disagreements — my arithmetic against an estimate already in
# the reference data. Neither side was a published figure. A cross-check that
# compares two guesses is worse than no cross-check, because it reads like
# `size-families.tsv` is what this project measures against. Nothing checked
# that IT was right. These are the manufacturers' own figures, kept separate
# so the two can disagree: a single file cannot check itself.
# Where a maker's manual and website differ slightly (the Geo 7 manual says
# 22.1 m2 and AR 5.15 where the website says 22.2 and 5.16) the website table
